theorems.name: Submission.ted_lpm_fcm_cutoff_mass_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), 0 < T → μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u : ℝ, T ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / t)) μ ∧ Integrable (fun x => ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t)) μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) ∂μ) (-(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ) / t) t
